name: groundline-insights
description: Public-source, opt-in self-hosted Insights companion for GroundLine.

interface.longDescription: GroundLine Insights is the public-source, private-data companion for the GroundLine core. It owns four fail-open Codex lifecycle hooks, local collector state, Tailnet transport, ClickHouse ingestion and reports, Grafana dashboards, and generic self-hosted deployment tooling. It does not ship GroundLine guidance skills, change global Codex configuration, install a daemon, or replace Codex execution and permission behavior.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the GroundLine Insights collector, upload, ClickHouse, and Grafana evidence lanes without exposing secrets or raw Codex content.
